extracted.intended_audience: SBIR/STTR small business applicants and institutional subaward personnel preparing PHS 398/SF424 (R&R) budgets, budget justifications, and research plans
extracted.subtask_short: SBIR PHS 398 budget and research plan
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and form-derived requirements for preparing SBIR/STTR (PHS 398 / SF424 (R&R)) budgets, budget justifications, subaward budgets, and the research plan (Specific Aims/Research Strategy) including required certifications and milestone-based aims for a Phase I/II diagnostic device project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment listing and threshold
rubrics_metrics.description: List items and dollar amount for each equipment item exceeding $5,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide each equipment item and funds requested; include 'Total funds requested for all equipment listed in the attached file' and attach equipment detail file when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Domestic and foreign travel costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Separate Domestic Travel Costs (Incl. Canada, Mexico and U.S. Possessions) and Foreign Travel Costs and provide totals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report line items for domestic and foreign travel and sum to 'Total Travel Cost'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participant/trainee support costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Report tuition/fees/health insurance, stipends, travel, subsistence, other support costs, and number of participants/trainees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide line-item funds requested for each category and total 'Participant/Trainee Support Costs'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other direct costs categories
rubrics_metrics.description: Itemize Other Direct Costs including Materials and Supplies, Publication Costs, Consultant Services, ADP/Computer Services, Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs, Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees, Alterations and Renovations, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List each category and provide funds requested; include a 'Total Other Direct Costs' line.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct costs and total direct costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Calculate Total Direct Costs (A thru F) by summing personnel, equipment, travel, participant support, other direct costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure all section subtotals are included so the 'Total Direct Costs' (G) is correct and documented.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect costs (F&A) reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), and calculate Total Indirect Costs; identify the Cognizant Federal Agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate the Indirect Cost Type (e.g., Modified Total Direct Costs), the rate, base, total and list agency name/POC/phone for cognizant agency. Use the specified base (e.g., Modified Total Direct Costs) when required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total direct and indirect institutional costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Sum Total Direct Costs (G) and Total Indirect Costs (H) to report 'Total Direct and Indirect Institutional Costs (G + H)'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include this total in the cumulative budget and ensure consistency with section subtotals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: If applicable, report any Fee (J) requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include Fee as a separate line in the budget when allowed by the agency/program instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget justification file requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a Budget Justification attachment (only one file).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach a single Budget Justification PDF describing personnel effort, roles, and justification of other costs; reference file name and mime type as required by the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personnel justification and effort reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: For each Senior/Key Person and other personnel, specify name, role, calendar months, percent effort (FTE), requested salary, fringe benefits, and duties/responsibilities in the Budget Justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide short biographies and explain specific responsibilities (e.g., supervise assay development, coordinate distribution, analyze data). State calendar months and percent FTE for the relevant budget period(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational in-kind resources disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose resources that the applicant organization will provide at its own cost and will not charge to the grant (e.g., FilmArray pouches, instrument availability).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly state if items (pouches, instruments) are provided in-kind and not budgeted; explain instrument availability if not included in the budget.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subaward budget components
rubrics_metrics.description: Subaward budgets must include the same structured sections as the prime: Section A (Senior/Key Person), Section B (Other Personnel), Section C (Equipment), Section D (Travel), Section E (Participant/Trainee Support), Section F (Other Direct Costs), Section H (Indirect Costs), Section I (Total Direct & Indirect), and an attached subaward Budget Justification file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide detailed line items, personnel effort, equipment (> $5,000) listing, indirect cost calculations including cognizant federal agency, and a single Budget Justification attachment for each subaward.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cumulative budget reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide cumulative budget totals across sections (A-J) for the application and for each subaward, including totals for salary/wages/fringe, equipment, travel, participant support, other direct costs, direct costs (A-F), indirect costs, total direct and indirect (G+H), and fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure cumulative totals are reconciled and presented per budget period and for the entire project period.

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR/STTR applicant certifications and eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Certify that at the time of award the organization meets small business eligibility criteria and answer program-specific questions (e.g., HUBZone status, whether research will be performed entirely in the United States, disclosure permission for contact by third parties).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete required yes/no certifications and provide explanatory attachments if 'no' where allowed; use SBA HUBZone mapping utility as referenced.

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR commercialization plan requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: If submitting a Phase II or Phase I/Phase II Fast-Track Application, include a Commercialization Plan per agency-specific instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach commercialization plan when required and follow agency-specific formatting/instruction rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR-specific disclosure of prior Phase II awards
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose if the applicant has received SBIR Phase II awards from the Federal Government and provide a company commercialization history per agency instructions if yes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach commercialization history file if previous Phase II awards exist; the form collects number of prior Phase II awards (e.g., fewer than 15).

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR PD/PI primary employment requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the Project Director/Principal Investigator will have primary employment with the small business at the time of award (applies to SBIR).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide 'yes/no' and any required explanations or attachments per program rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: STTR PD/PI appointment and effort requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: For STTR applications, PD/PI must have a formal appointment/commitment with either the small business or the research institution and must devote at least 10% effort to the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer both parts (formal appointment/commitment and >=10% effort) and include documentation if requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: STTR work distribution requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: In STTR joint R&D, the small business must perform at least 40% of the work and the research institution at least 30% of the work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document and justify the percentage distribution of work in the application and subaward documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims: SA1 — assay panel development
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop a FilmArray Meningoencephalitis (FAME) panel by combining assays from existing panels with new assays and for each FAME assay implement a corresponding published or in-house singleplex real-time PCR assay to allow sensitivity comparisons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Milestone: develop a FilmArray pouch comprised of assays for listed pathogens with demonstration of sensitive and specific pathogen detection in spiked CSF samples. Modify or replace pouch assays that perform less well than conventional assays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims: SA2 — nucleic acid extraction optimization
rubrics_metrics.description: Optimize nucleic acid purification steps and investigate simple concentration steps to concentrate bacteria/viruses from 1–2 ml CSF to the 0.1 ml injected into the pouch to improve sensitivity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Milestones: (1) Demonstrate that FAME pouch performs equally with buffer and CSF; (2) develop a protocol lowering the limit of detection (LoD) by at least five-fold while not adding more than 1 hour to total test time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims: SA3 — preclinical clinical evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Perform preclinical evaluation of the FAME pouch by testing up to 300 CSF samples from pediatric and adult patients with suspected ME, comparing FAME results to clinical standard-of-care testing supplemented with additional PCR assays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Milestone: demonstrate clinical sensitivity and specificity at least equal to existing clinical practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Success criteria for regulatory progression
rubrics_metrics.description: A successful Phase I outcome is defined as a FilmArray pouch capable of rapid and accurate detection/identification of common ME pathogens to support analytical and clinical performance evaluations for a future 510(k) submission to FDA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Phase II should focus on analytical and clinical performance evaluations and include results to support a 510(k) application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research justification and significance expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: The Research Strategy should justify significance: the public health importance of the problem, limitations of current diagnostics, and how the proposed technology will improve rapid organism-specific diagnosis and clinical outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrate how rapid accurate etiologic diagnosis will affect therapy decisions, reduce inappropriate antimicrobial use, and potentially reduce ancillary testing and length of stay; cite epidemiology and clinical impact to support need.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attachment and documentation practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide and label attachments for Research Plan sections (Specific Aims, Research Strategy, Protection of Human Subjects, Inclusion sections, Vertebrate Animals, Consortium/Contractual Arrangements, Letters of Support, Resource Sharing Plans, Appendix, etc.) and for subaward budget justifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the form's attachment fields; include required supporting documents (e.g., budget justification PDFs) and limit the number/type as directed (e.g., only one Budget Justification file).
